map.Token 数量估算是做什么的？: What does Token Count Estimator do?
map.如何使用Token 数量估算？: How do I use Token Count Estimator?
map.Token 数量估算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Token Count Estimator best for?
map.根据文本长度估算大模型 Token 数量。: Estimate the token count of a large model from text length.
map.估算 token 数 = ⌈字符数 × 语言系数 / 重叠系数⌉；英文参考 =: Estimated tokens = ceil(characters x language factor / overlap factor); English reference = ceil(characters x 0.3 / 1.5); cost ~ tokens / 10^6 x unit price
map.不同语言与分词器的压缩率差异很大：中文常约 1–1.5 字符/token，英文约: Compression ratios vary widely by language and tokenizer: Chinese is often about 1-1.5 chars/token, English about 4 chars/token. This formula is an order-of-magnitude estimate; exact billing must call the model official tokenizer; code and numbers split finer, so actual tokens often exceed the plain-text estimate.
map.根据文本长度与语言比例估算大模型 token 数，帮助用户把控上下文窗口。: Estimate large-model token counts from text length and language ratio, helping users manage the context window.
map.中文约每 1~2 字 1 token，英文约每 4 字符 1 token，具体随: Chinese is about 1 token per 1-2 chars, English about 1 token per 4 chars; details vary by tokenizer.
map.估算用于预判 API 调用成本与是否触发上下文截断。: The estimate is used to predict API call cost and whether context truncation is triggered.
map.一段 800 中文字的文本，按 1.5 字/token 估算≈533 token: An 800-Chinese-character text at 1.5 chars/token ~ 533 tokens; adding 200 English words ~ 260 tokens, total ~ 793 tokens, about 80% of a 1k context.
map.估算和真实计费差多少？: How far is the estimate from real billing?
map.量级基本一致，精确值取决于具体模型分词器；中文差异可能被放大数倍，正式计费以厂商: The order of magnitude is basically consistent; the exact value depends on the specific model tokenizer; Chinese differences can be amplified several times, and official billing uses the token count returned by the vendor.
map.怎么避免超出上下文？: How to avoid exceeding the context?
map.先在本地估算文本 token，长文本做摘要或分块，预留生成空间(通常留 20%~: First estimate text tokens locally; summarize or chunk long texts, and reserve generation space (usually 20%-30%) to avoid truncation and information loss.
